# Mộc Homestay & Hotel — Golden Bay Bãi Dài, Cam Lâm (Cam Ranh, Vietnam)

> Quiet 6-room family-run homestay & boutique hotel 800m from Bãi Dài Beach and 12 km (15 min) from Cam Ranh International Airport (CXR), hosted personally by Linh. Rated 9.0/10 on Booking.com (95 reviews) and 4.8/5 on Google Maps (56 reviews). Direct booking saves 10–15% off OTA prices.

- **Official Signage / Business Name:** Mộc Homestay & Hotel (Facade sign: «MỘC HOTEL», Registered entity: HO KINH DOANH MOC HOTEL)
- **Address:** D17-02-22, Golden Bay Urban Area, Bãi Dài, Cam Hải Đông, Thôn Cù Hin, Cam Lâm, Khánh Hòa 655240, Vietnam

- **Private Beach Access (Exclusive Perk):** Free access for Mộc Hotel guests to host Linh's beachfront wooden stilt lounge **Sea Camp • Mộc Beach** directly on Bãi Dài Beach (1.4 km / 3 min by electric scooter) — shaded loungers, hammocks, freshwater rinse shower, changing/locker room, plus optional kayak/SUP rental and group BBQ area (https://www.google.com/maps/place/Sea+Camp/@12.1136648,109.1952667,17z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m6!3m5!1s0x31708ba99def57cb:0xf22c45b30e09b348!8m2!3d12.1136648!4d109.1952667!16s%2Fg%2F11p1kk09t0)

- **Direct Nightly Rates:** King Double Room (25 m², 2 guests) from 450,000 VND/night; Quadruple Balcony Room (28 m², 4 guests) from 550,000 VND/night; Weekly & Monthly stays save 10–15%
